idea-plugin.name: GHC GitHub Auth
idea-plugin.description:
Companion login methods for the bundled GitHub plugin, for organizations that block the "JetBrains IDE Integration" OAuth app via OAuth App access restrictions.
  • Log in with GitHub CLI — reuses the token of your locally authenticated gh CLI (the GitHub CLI OAuth app is commonly allow-listed).
  • Log in with Device Flow — runs the GitHub Device Flow against an OAuth app client id you provide (e.g. one your organization has approved).
Acquired tokens are stored into the bundled GitHub plugin's normal account store, so Pull Requests, Gists and clone integration work as usual.
